##### Project general facts

One Residence is a contemporary residential development that brings together architectural expression and refined urban living. Defined by its striking façade, the building showcases a rich interplay of textures and materials, complemented by floor-to-ceiling windows that open up sweeping views of the city skyline. Bronze-finished balconies and copper accents enhance its vertical elegance, while the overall design reflects a balance between modern sophistication and timeless appeal.

The project offers a collection of thoughtfully designed residences, created to suit a variety of lifestyles while maintaining a consistent standard of quality and detail. Interiors are characterized by a warm palette of beige tones enriched with brass and copper elements, creating a refined yet vibrant atmosphere. Carefully curated textures and patterns add depth and personality, while the layouts are planned to ensure both functionality and comfort, resulting in homes that feel both elegant and inviting.

Residents benefit from a living environment defined by quality finishes and premium specifications. Interiors feature porcelain tile flooring, engineered stone countertops, and lacquered cabinetry, complemented by accent detailing in bathrooms. Kitchens are fully equipped with built-in appliances by SMEG, while sanitary ware and fittings are provided by Villeroy & Boch. Together, these elements create a cohesive residential experience that blends modern design, high-quality materials, and everyday practicality.

##### Location description and benefits

As the name suggests, Downtown Dubai is the centre of Dubai, constantly evolving at a fast pace. Home to many landmarks and world-famous attractions, including Burj Khalifa, the Dubai Mall and Dancing Fountains, the area is a hub of activities. The prime location keeps Downtown busy throughout the year. 

Constantly attracting tourists, there’re always some new things to do in Downtown Dubai. The area is best known for offering a luxurious lifestyle. It used to be a vertical community, but many villas have also been added to the real estate market. As per Bayut’s 2020 Rental Market Report, it is the second most popular area offering luxury apartments for rent after Dubai Marina. 

Downtown is well connected to other key commercial and residential areas in the city. Strategically located along Sheikh Zayed Road, E11, across Al Wasl and bordering Business Bay, it is a pretty active and bustling neighbourhood. Downtown is one of Dubai’s best areas for non-drivers and frequent travellers. Many amenities, including upscale hotels, chic leisure points and massive shopping centres, make Downtown Dubai a sought-after address and “the centre of now.”
